title: Open Shorebird release root, contract v2
description: Payload of a release-root envelope: the offline Ed25519 root key set (k of n) of one root version. Version 1 is signed by a threshold of its own keys; version N+1 by thresholds of version N and of its own keys (signature domain open-shorebird.release-root-signature.v2:). The hardened engine compiles one version's exact payload bytes as its pin (GN shorebird_release_root). Payload bytes are canonical JSON. See docs/HARDENING_CONTRACTS.md section 10.
